scope: Each exact declared finite history, value domain and quorum basis; all predicate interpretations with supplied positive facts pinned. No history extensions. These results are not unbounded proofs.

ThyHBB1.name: Liveness 1
ThyHBB1.formula: forall l,v. ((box[l] live) & (exists1 w. dia[] past propose(w))) -> (dia[] past (live & dia[] past propose(v)) -> live -> sometime deliver(l,l,v))
ThyHBB1.nonvacuity: exists l,v. ((box[l] live) & (exists1 w. dia[] past propose(w))) & (dia[] past (live & dia[] past propose(v)))

source.title: Heterogeneous trust in reliable broadcast via modal logic and history structures

ThyHBB1.name: Liveness 2
ThyHBB1.formula: forall a,b,l,v. ((dia[a,b] true) & (box[b] live) & (box[] safe(l))) -> (dia[] past deliver(a,l,v) -> live -> sometime deliver(b,l,v))
ThyHBB1.nonvacuity: exists a,b,l,v. ((dia[a,b] true) & (box[b] live) & (box[] safe(l))) & (dia[] past deliver(a,l,v))

source.title: Heterogeneous trust in reliable broadcast via modal logic and history structures

ThyHBB1.name: Agreement
ThyHBB1.formula: forall a,b,l,m,v,w. ((dia[a,b] seq)) -> ((dia[] past deliver(a,l,v)) & (dia[] past deliver(b,m,w)) -> v=w)
ThyHBB1.nonvacuity: exists a,b,l,m,v,w. ((dia[a,b] seq)) & ((dia[] past deliver(a,l,v)) & (dia[] past deliver(b,m,w)))

source.title: Heterogeneous trust in reliable broadcast via modal logic and history structures
